exposure: Intracisternal administration of phosphate buffered saline (PBS)
outcome: Safety (abnormal behavior, CNS magnetic resonance imaging, clinical chemistry, histopathology)
cohort: The study participants were nonhuman primates (NHPs).
finding: Intracisternal delivery of AAVrh.10hCLN2 in nonhuman primates was safe and resulted in wide distribution of TPP-1 in the brain and CSF at potentially therapeutic levels.
